senses.gloss: f. (βασιλική, sub. στοά) basilica, a building with colonnades for holding courts, also meeting place for merchants, exchange, forum.
units: <cite ref="Yoma 25a:4">Yoma 25ᵃ</cite> <he>כמין ב׳ גדולה</he> was built in the style of a large basilica (semicircular).
<cite ref="Tosefta Sukkah 4:6">Tosef. Succ. IV, 6</cite> (describing the Alexandrian Synagogue); <cite ref="Sukkah 51b:6">Succ. 51ᵇ</cite>.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 68:12">Gen. R. s. 68</cite> <he>עולים לב׳ וכ׳</he> one goes up to the basil. and finds the King holding court.
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 15:22">Ex. R. s. 15</cite>; Tanḥ. Ḥaye 3 <he>שמא אצל ב׳ וכ׳</he> perhaps he wanted me to wait for him near the basilica (on the forum).

<cite ref="Mishnah Tahorot 6:8">Toh. VI, 8</cite>; <cite ref="Tosefta Tahorot 7:12">Tosef. ib. VII, 12</cite>; a. fr. [<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Bava Batra 4:6:2">Y. B. Bath. IV, 14ᶜ</cite> bot. <cite ref="B01002"><he>בסלקי</he></cite>, v. <cite ref="K00752"><he>כַּלְכּוֹס</he></cite>.]—Pl. <he>בָּסִילְקָאוֹת</he>.

<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 16b:14">Ab. Zar. 16ᵇ</cite> <he>שלש ב׳ הן וכ׳</he> there are three kinds of basilicas, for Kings (holding court), for baths, and royal treasuries (τὸ βασιλικόν, sub. ταμεῖον, S.).

<cite ref="Tosefta Ohalot 18:18">Tosef. Ohol. XVIII, 18</cite> selling wheat <he>בב׳ שלהן</he> in their (the gentiles’) exchanges. [<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 34:12">Lev. R. s. 34</cite> <cite ref="B01002"><he>בסלקי</he></cite>, read <he>בפִילָקִי</he>.]
